title: blackjack skin (DRAFT, Phase 1)
description: DRAFT for the Phase 3 plugin engine/games/blackjack/ (SPEC 3.3), generalised from engine/games/_legacy/brilliant-21.math.js (6 decks, dealer stands on soft 17, 3:2 natural, double any two, split once). The skin names the natural and picks the rules the maths supports; the RTP printed on the page comes from engine/tools/simulate-21.mjs --spec <skin> stored in content/games/<slug>.json rtp. Not yet read by any code.

dealer.description: Dealer stands (S17) or hits (H17) on soft 17.

naturalPays.description: 6:5 is refused: it is the worse game sold as the same one.

cutAt.description: Reshuffle when this share of the shoe is left.
